title: When the Crown Burns
author: Zephyrine Coldharbour
blurb: Dominic Sterling, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
